attempts.summary: Configured split-horizon DNS: node1 (VyOS) forwards DNS on its lan-a interface (10.10.1.254/24) and answers app.internal -> 10.10.1.10 (node3) via a static-host-mapping in pdns-recursor. node2 (OPNsense) was given a new lan-b interface (opt1/vtnet2, 10.10.2.254/24) with a matching firewall pass rule, and Unbound answers app.internal -> 10.10.2.10 (node4) via a host override. Both hosts (node3, node4) were switched to static NM addressing on their second NIC with DNS pointed only at their own router, and each independently resolves app.internal to its own IP and reaches a demo HTTP service by that name. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time (boot-id/boottime changed on each), and full recovery (addressing, DNS service, resolution, and service reachability) was re-verified after each reboot.
